values.value: Teachers mark each session Present, Late, Absent or Excused. Excused absences do not count against the attendance rate. A learner below the attendance threshold is flagged (organisation default {{Setting:Default_Attendance_Threshold}} as a fraction; a branch can set its own). Learners below the threshold, absent three sessions in a row, with overdue fees or a low course score are scored for retention risk every night and high-risk learners get a follow-up task for the branch manager.
